files.caption:
Knud Anderson Farmstead
The east façade consists of the east gable-end of the stone house and the east elevation of the 1873 single-story addition.

files.title: File:Knud Anderson Farmstead Douglas Co KS Anderson House south facade.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Knud Anderson Farmstead
The Anderson House consists of the original 1 ½ story stone house built in the National Folk style, an 1873 single-story wood-framed addition, and an 1897 single-story wood-framed shed addition.

files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Knud Anderson Farmstead
The west façade consists of the west gable-end of the stone house and the west elevation of the 1890 single-story addition.
